slot.brief: Given a multi-step reaction sequence (combination of steps), find the overall K by combining, reversing, and scaling individual equilibrium constants; determine K for the net reaction.

stem: For the equilibria $\text{H}_2(g)+\text{Cl}_2(g)\rightleftharpoons2\text{HCl}(g)$, $K_1=2$; $2\text{HCl}(g)+\dfrac12\text{O}_2(g)\rightleftharpoons\text{H}_2\text{O}(g)+\text{Cl}_2(g)$, $K_2=4$; and $2\text{O}(g)\rightleftharpoons\text{O}_2(g)$, $K_3=64$, find $K$ for $2\text{H}_2\text{O}(g)+2\text{O}(g)\rightleftharpoons2\text{H}_2(g)+2\text{O}_2(g)$. All equilibrium constants are dimensionless.

verdicts.working: Adding the first two equilibria gives H₂ + ½O₂ ⇌ H₂O, with K = 2 × 4 = 8. Reverse and double it to obtain 2H₂O ⇌ 2H₂ + O₂, with K = 1/64. Adding 2O ⇌ O₂ (K = 64) gives the target reaction, so K = (1/64) × 64 = 1.

working:
Reverse and double reactions 1 and 2; use reaction 3 as written. $K=K_1^{-2}K_2^{-2}K_3=\dfrac{64}{2^2\times4^2}=1$

Independent check: Adding the first two equilibria gives H₂ + ½O₂ ⇌ H₂O, with K = 2 × 4 = 8. Reverse and double it to obtain 2H₂O ⇌ 2H₂ + O₂, with K = 1/64. Adding 2O ⇌ O₂ (K = 64) gives the target reaction, so K = (1/64) × 64 = 1.
solution:
Add reactions 1 and 2 to obtain $\text{H}_2+\frac12\text{O}_2\rightleftharpoons\text{H}_2\text{O}$, with $K=K_1K_2=8$. Reverse and double this reaction, then add reaction 3:
$$K=(K_1K_2)^{-2}K_3=8^{-2}\times64=1.$$
